title: Network Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Network Engineer to join our rapidly growing office in Mumbai. You'll be responsible for the design and management of both our enterprise and trading networks, optimising our systems for reliability, scalability and performance characteristics, like latency, to help us remain competitive in the market.
   

  

 Optiver’s bespoke infrastructure offers a diverse network engineering experience. Advance your career in a unique environment, where you'll be supported to find the simplest solutions to some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
   

  

 In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996\. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005\), Hong Kong (2007\), Shanghai (2012\) and Singapore (2021\). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
   

  

  

* Providing technical expertise to support a high\-frequency trading environment
* Monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving incidents across network, security, and systems infrastructure
* Automating and monitoring network infrastructure to improve reliability and reduce manual operational work
* Supporting end\-to\-end infrastructure deployments across data centres, offices, and global WAN environments
* Assisting with planned upgrades and maintenance including migrations, capacity expansions, and hardware or software upgrades
* Ensuring the stability and performance of WAN connectivity between data centres and colocations
* Contributing to capacity planning, connectivity improvements, and traffic flow optimisation
* Driving improvements in infrastructure reliability and performance, including evaluating new technologies for use in the trading platform
* Contributing to the standardisation and automation of our environments through Infrastructure as Code
* Collaborating with developers, researchers, and hardware engineers to provide a stable and scalable platform for trading systems


**What You'll Get**
 You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high\-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

 In return for your expertise, you will have access to a range of Optiver perks, including:
   

  

  

* A performance\-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in\-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.


**Who You Are**
* 3\+ years of experience working as a network engineer in an operational environment
* Strong troubleshooting skills across LAN, WAN, and firewall infrastructure
* Experience monitoring and operating international WAN networks
* Solid understanding of network transport and routing protocols such as TCP/UDP, OSPF, BGP, and Multicast
* Experience working in multi\-vendor network environments (e.g. Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto)
* Strong knowledge of L2/L3 networking, firewalls, and network security
* Experience using monitoring and telemetry systems to analyse network performance and capacity
* Comfortable working with Unix/Linux systems in data centre environments
* Experience managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Git, Terraform, or Ansible
* Ability to coordinate work with vendors, service providers, and remote smart hands
* Certifications such as Arista ACE, PCNSE, CCNP, or CCIE are a plus


**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**
 Optiver is committed to
   

  

 diversity and inclusion
   

  

 .
   

  

 We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via
   

  

 careers@optiver.com.au
   

  

 .

title: Infrastructure and Network Engineer
description:
**About Kagool** 




 We are a fast\-growing IT consultancy specializing in the transformation of complex Global enterprises. We are looking for passionate and hardworking individuals to help deliver for our global customer base. We embrace the opportunities of the future and work proactively to make good use of technology. As you can imagine, this means that we have a vibrant and diverse mix of skills and people making Kagool a great place to work.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 As an Infrastructure and Network Engineer you will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting an organization's IT infrastructure and network systems. This role ensures high availability, performance, and security of networks, servers, and related infrastructure components. You will have the opportunity to deliver services in an environment that involves designing and implementing solutions incorporated with the best of breed technologies, frameworks, and best practices. This provides a unique opportunity for someone who is passionate about technology and have a deep commitment to deliver services to customers. You will be working with the latest Microsoft 365 offering – products and services and will be responsible for Active Directory and Microsoft 365 tenant setup, Exchange and SharePoint administration; providing end\-user support, provide hardware and software support working in collaborating with the IT Manager to ensure operational security, Maintenance and Governance.
 



  





**Key Duties and Responsibilities** 



* On premise and Azure Active directory design, configure, support and maintenance
* Microsoft 365 tenant setup and configuration including all security configurations.
* Microsoft Defender configuration and monitoring setup using various Microsoft services available through M365 offerings.
* Ensuring the operational health of the O365, SharePoint online environment including security, availability, performance, interoperability, and reliability
* Design/Maintenance/sustainment of existing client SharePoint sites and sub sites, lists, libraries, and content (including pages, workflows, and items)
* Maintenance, and sustainment of additional complementary functionality for customer sub sites, lists, libraries, and content
* Administer and support an enterprise\-level Microsoft O365 emails and team’s
 
 services/configuration
* Microsoft Cost and License Management
* Design, implement, and manage network infrastructure including LAN, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and wireless networks.
* Install, configure, and maintain network hardware such as routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity or infrastructure issues.
* Maintain server infrastructure (physical and virtual environments).
* Implement security measures such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, and network segmentation.
* Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) if applicable.
* Perform network upgrades, patches, and capacity planning.
* Support disaster recovery planning and business continuity strategies.
* Document network configurations, diagrams, and procedures.
* Collaborate with system administrators, DevOps teams, and security teams.
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and IT policies.
* End user security setup – Intune, VPN and other software deployment, configurations
* General IT: End\-user support and training for hardware and software – MS 365, Teams, Outlook, and other basic software used by end users
* Training and educating end\-users on O365 capabilities and collaboration tools (OneDrive, teams, OneNote, Outlook etc)
* HA, Proxy setup and monitoring
* Operational Security, Maintenance and Governance.



  





**Additionally responsible for** 
  
 


* Logical and physical controls of the company’s IT system by providing, on a quarterly basis, documented assurance that access to computer resources (data, equipment, and facilities) is reasonable and restricted to authorized individuals. (Asset Management)
* Perform software upgrades and patches (bios, firmware upgrades, etc.)
* Troubleshoot various Microsoft  365 issues including connectivity and mobility
* Conduct routine monitoring and analysis to include Audit Log Reports evaluation, system and storage utilization reports, site and system usage, growth reports, and manage site collection quota settings.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience administering O365, Exchange, Teams, Azure Active Directory
* Experience with SharePoint environment
* Experience working with network and security hardware/software
* System administrator experience and ability to provide technical and end\-user support through remote tools
* Experience working with networking – IP, DNS, SMTP, DHCP, Firewalls and Microsoft Intune, Defender, Purview and security tools.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CISCO or other Network certifications.
* 4\-7 years of IT experience.



  





**Career at Kagool** 
  
 



 A career at Kagool will give you a path towards progression and opportunities, with the current rate of growth we at Kagool have dedicated time towards individual growth, recognizing individual contributions, filling the team with a strong sense of purpose along with providing a fun, flexible and friendly work environment.

title: 3D VR Graphic Designer
description:
**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
*Brief introduction of the department, team, purpose, and missions. Highlight what is unique to your team.*
 Sanofi Business Operations – Medical Tower is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CMO, and R\&D, Data \& Digital functions. SBO strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, Globally.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
*The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:*
*Design and produce Virtual Reality (VR) experiences and deliverables such as immersive medical training simulations, educational VR modules, explainer experiences, mechanism of action visualizations, and interactive scientific storytelling — as per provided guidelines and specifications. Also provide support on 360° video editing, spatial audio integration, VR environment design, interactive infographics, and other immersive media as required.*
* People: Maintain effective relationships with the Content Enhancement team and Scientific Writers in SBO (and global stakeholders, based on project requirements), with the objective of ensuring VR\-based scientific communication materials meet stakeholder expectations and learning outcomes.
* Performance: (1\) Deliver VR\-based publication and medical education content (interactive modules, immersive presentations, virtual exhibits, etc.) within agreed timelines and quality standards. (2\) Extend support to develop digital and interactive deliverables including VR walkthroughs, patient education simulators, 360° videos, animated icons, and other immersive formats as needed..
* Process: (1\) Collaborate closely with designers and SBO Scientific Writers to understand project\-specific requirements and deliver high\-quality VR outputs on time. (2\) Proactively communicate and flag any issues related to project timelines or input quality to the Team Lead. (3\) Prioritize and manage assigned VR projects, adhering to defined quality standards and delivering on schedule per stakeholder specifications. (4\) Use VR development tools and 3D modeling techniques to create immersive environments, interactive elements, and realistic simulations. (5\) Develop storyboards and user journey maps to visualize VR scenes and create engaging, scientifically accurate experiences. (6\) Create and manage 3D digital assets optimized for VR platforms (including low\-poly modeling, texture optimization, and performance tuning). (7\) Interpret concept art and scientific inputs to build virtual characters, anatomical models, environments, and interactive props. (8\) Design and develop original visual assets and interactive components specifically for VR video and simulation deliverables. (9\) Prototype and iterate on VR models, interactions, and navigation flows based on feedback from Scientific Writers and stakeholders. (10\) Recreate real\-world medical or laboratory environments in VR for training and educational purposes. (11\) Stay updated on the latest advancements in VR design, immersive storytelling, 360° capture, and interactive development tools. (12\) Assist in problem\-solving, suggest best practices, and explore new software, technologies, and resources to improve VR workflows. (13\) Actively participate in team meetings and contribute ideas to enhance VR project execution. (14\) Share VR\-related best practices, tools, and learnings with the team. (15\) Demonstrate flexibility to adapt to evolving project demands and deliver high\-quality VR outputs on time.


**About You**
* Experience: 2 to 6 years of experience in VR content creation, immersive media, or interactive 3D experiences.


 Desirable: Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry, particularly in creating VR\-based scientific or medical communication.
   

  

* Soft skills: Stakeholder management; communication skills; and ability to work independently and and collaboratively in a cross\-functional team environment.
* Technical skills:
* Must have strong hands\-on experience with VR development platforms (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and tools for 360° video editing, spatial audio, and VR interactivity.
* Proficiency in Blender, Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere Pro (including 360° video workflow), Adobe Photoshop, and Illustrator.
* Experience with VR headset platforms (e.g., Meta Quest, HTC Vive) and optimization for standalone/mobile VR.
* Knowledge of useful plugins/scripts in After Effects and Blender for particle effects, animations, and VR compositing.
* Strong understanding of VR UX/UI principles, including user navigation, interaction design, and motion comfort.
* Skilled in 3D modeling and texturing with optimization for real\-time rendering in VR.
* Ability to create VR\-ready 3D assets that balance visual quality and performance.
* Good knowledge of lighting, rendering, and spatial audio integration in immersive environments.
* Ability to create visually compelling and engaging VR experiences that enhance scientific understanding.
* Strong capability to translate complex scientific or medical information into intuitive, interactive VR experiences.
* Creative, aesthetic, and independent thinker with awareness of current trends in immersive design and experiential storytelling.
* Experience adhering to brand guidelines and developing reusable VR templates and modules.
* Education: Graduate or postgraduate degree in any field. Preference for graphic design, multimedia, animation, or digital arts, with a focus on scientific visualization or immersive media
* Languages: Excellent knowledge of English language (spoken and written)

 HSR, Bengaluru

title: Product Manager
description:
**Location** 
 : Vashi, Navi Mumbai
 



**Experience** 
 : 2 to 5 years
 



  





**About Grexa** 




 Grexa AI builds growth software for local businesses in India.
 



  





 Salons, clinics, gyms, tuition centres, restaurants — millions of business owners run successful businesses, but much of their marketing still happens through phone calls, WhatsApp, memory, and manual follow\-ups.
 



  





 We’re building the app that changes that.
 



  





 Our customers are not software\-native. They don’t wake up wanting another app. They care about getting more customers, bringing customers back, and growing their business. Our job is to make powerful growth tools feel simple enough that they become part of a business owner’s daily workflow.
 



  





 The founding team previously built Testbook from zero to 25M monthly visitors, 2\.5M paid users, and ₹250 Cr in annual revenue before its acquisition by Classplus. We’ve scaled a consumer product before. Now we’re starting again.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We’re looking for a Product Manager who wants to build from first principles.
 



  





 This is not a roadmap management role. This is not a coordination role.
 



  





 You’ll talk to customers, understand how they operate, identify opportunities, decide what to build, work with engineers and designers to ship it, and measure whether it worked.
 



  





 Our users are typically 35\+, run profitable businesses, and are often using software like this for the first time. There is no established playbook for how they should behave. The product has to earn its place in their business from the very first session.
 



 The challenge is not building features. The challenge is helping business owners adopt a new way of running and growing their business.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own a product area end\-to\-end, from discovery to launch to iteration
* Talk to customers every week through calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and feedback conversations
* Develop a deep understanding of how local businesses acquire, retain, and communicate with customers
* Design onboarding and activation experiences that help users see value immediately
* Work closely with engineering and design to ship fast and learn quickly
* Run experiments across activation, engagement, retention, and monetisation
* Track product metrics and use them to guide decisions
* Kill features that aren’t working and double down on the ones that are



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 You’ll be responsible for helping business owners adopt the product as part of their daily workflow.
 



**Key outcomes include:** 



* Faster activation of new users
* Higher engagement and product usage
* Improved retention and habit formation
* Stronger customer outcomes and business impact



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of product management experience, ideally at a fast\-growing consumer or mobile\-first product company
* Experience working on activation, engagement, retention, or growth problems
* You’ve taken something from idea to launch and owned the outcome
* Strong intuition for mobile user behaviour across Android and iOS
* Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information
* Strong written communication and product thinking
* Curious, resourceful, and highly execution\-oriented
* Excited to talk to customers directly and use those insights to shape the product



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building for SMBs or local businesses
* Experience in a 0\-to\-1 product environment
* Experience creating new user behaviours rather than optimising existing ones
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI\-powered product experiences



  





**Why This Role** 



* End\-to\-end ownership from problem discovery to shipped product
* Direct access to founders and rapid decision\-making
* A small team with high trust and high responsibility
* A chance to define the product DNA of a company from its earliest days
* Customers whose problems are tangible, important, and easy to understand
* The opportunity to build software that helps millions of local businesses grow



  





**This Role Is Probably Not For You If** 



* You prefer managing roadmaps over discovering problems
* You need extensive data before making decisions
* You enjoy process more than building
* You want clearly defined requirements handed to you



  





 You’d rather work on incremental optimisation than creating something new
 



 If you enjoy talking to customers, shipping quickly, and figuring things out from first principles, we’d love to talk.

title: Business Analyst - Payments Support
description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Business Analyst (BA) plays a critical role in enabling successful delivery of banking initiatives by bridging the gap between business needs and solutions. The BA works closely with stakeholders to elicit requirements, define scope, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives, regulatory obligations, and customer outcomes. This role operates at the intersection of desirability, feasibility, and viability \- translating customer insights and strategic intent into customer journey map, service blueprints, product concepts, and roadmaps.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Work Hours: General Shift**
**What will your day look like?**
 As a Business Analyst, you are accountable for:
   

  

* Design Strategy \& Visioning: − Define experience\-led strategies aligned to business goals and customer needs − Shape future\-state journeys and service models across banking domains
* Research \& Insight Development: − Lead qualitative and quantitative research to uncover customer behaviours, pain points, and opportunities − Translate insights into actionable design principles and opportunity areas
* Co\-Design \& Facilitation: − Facilitate cross\-functional workshops with stakeholders from product, risk, tech, and operations − Use storytelling and visualisation to align teams around shared vision
* Prototyping \& Validation: − Develop low to high fidelity prototypes to test desirability and usability − Validate concepts with customers, bankers, and business leads
* Strategic Influence: − Partner with business architects, product owners, and transformation leads to embed design into strategic planning − Influence investment decisions through compelling design narratives and artefacts


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* Creation of strategic design artefacts: − Service blueprints − Experience maps − Future\-state journey maps − Concept cards and opportunity canvases − Design hypotheses and test plans
* Workshop facilitation and co\-creation
* Design research planning and synthesis
* Visual storytelling and stakeholder alignment
* Agile and lean UX practices
* Tools: Figma, Mural, Miro, Adobe XD, Dovetail, Optimal Workshop, Signavio


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**So why join us?**
 ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
   

  

 We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
   

  

 We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
   

  

 To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 114843\.

 Engineer I Software Development

**What We Offer**

* Collaborative team environment with experienced engineering leadership

* Generous PTO and parental leave policies
* Performance\-based bonuses and growth opportunities
* Modern development tools and collaborative workspace



  
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.

 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Audit Associate – Statutory Audit
description:
Position : Audit Associate – Statutory Audit  

Department : Statutory Audit  

Employment type: Full\-time  

Positions: 1  

Qualification: Qualified CA (freshers welcome)  

Location : Hyderabad  

Experience : 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome  

Reporting To: Audit Manager / Engagement Partner


About Us


KVA is a boutique\-chartered accounting and advisory firm based in Hyderabad, with a legacy of over 40 years. Over the years, we have grown to become one of the leading firms in the city, serving a diverse set of clients across industries.


We operate within a strong global and sector\-focused ecosystem. Through our association with DFK International, we are connected to member firms across \~90 countries, enabling us to support clients on complex cross\-border matters. We are also closely aligned with Sathguru Management Consultants, bringing deep expertise in the life sciences sector and enhancing the value we deliver to clients in this space.


As a group of \~200 professionals, we work with businesses across India and internationally. While we continue to provide core audit and tax services, a significant part of our practice today focuses on high\-value advisory, including international taxation, structuring, and M\&A.


Role Description


We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Statutory Audit team in Hyderabad. The role involves working on end\-to\-end audit engagements for companies across industries, supporting the team in delivering high\-quality, compliant audits. It is a strong launchpad for a recently qualified CA, with direct exposure to clients, financial statements, and the full audit lifecycle.


Key Roles and Responsibilities  



* Execute substantive and analytical audit procedures under the guidance of seniors and managers.
* Vouch and verify transactions, test internal controls, and document working papers as per firm and SA (Standards on Auditing) requirements.
* Assist in preparation and review of financial statements as per applicable framework (Ind AS / AS) and Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
* Perform ledger scrutiny, ratio analysis, and identify unusual or high\-risk transactions.
* Support compliance checks across Income Tax, GST, TDS, and Companies Act requirements relevant to the audit.
* Maintain audit documentation and ensure timely closure of assigned sections.
* Coordinate with client finance teams to obtain data, reconciliations, and supporting evidence.
* Flag observations and potential audit issues to seniors promptly.


Qualification \& Eligibility  



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (recently cleared, both groups)
* Experience: 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome
* Completed articleship in audit/assurance preferred.


Skills  



* Sound knowledge of statutory audit procedures and applicable financial reporting frameworks (Ind AS / AS)
* Strong grasp of Standards on Auditing and the Companies Act, 2013
* Proficiency in MS Excel and working knowledge of accounting/audit software (Tally, audit tools, etc.)
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a methodical approach to documentation.
* Good written and verbal communication; ability to interact professionally with clients.
* Willingness to travel for fieldwork and to meet engagement deadlines.


What We Offer  



* Structured exposure to diverse audit engagements and industries
* Mentorship from experienced managers and partners
* A collaborative team environment with clear growth pathways

Explore exciting career opportunities with us and be a part of a vibrant team that values passion, excellence, and diversity.
Job Objective

This position exists for leading the Security \& Safety team at a property, ensuring full compliance with safety regulations, fire and life safety standards, and implementing security protocols effectively. The role involves managing incidents, conducting risk assessments, overseeing staff training, and ensuring a safe and secure environment for both guests and employees.

Essential Job Tasks

Assists in leading the security and safety function for a large property or manages a mid\-size property independently. Supervises staff, ensures compliance with security protocols, and leads emergency preparedness programs. Conducts risk assessments and leads incident investigations. Collaborates with property leadership on safety and security strategies, managing projects such as security system upgrades and safety audits.

Areas of Responsibility

1\. Leadership and Supervision of Security \& Safety Operations.  

* Operational Leadership. Lead day\-to\-day operations of the security and safety team, ensuring effective coordination among security supervisors, executives, and guards. Oversee the deployment and readiness of staff during routine operations and emergencies.
* Staff Scheduling and Performance Management. Manage staff rosters, ensuring adequate coverage for all shifts, including night patrols. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide feedback, and recommend training and development opportunities for team members.
* Leadership in Incident Response. Act as the point of escalation during security and safety incidents, ensuring swift and accurate responses by the team. Oversee the team's handling of incidents, from initial response to follow\-up investigation and reporting.

2\. Property Patrols, Safety Inspections, and Incident Management.  

* Regular Patrol Supervision. Direct and oversee routine property patrols, focusing on critical areas such as entry/exit points, guest room corridors, parking areas, and high\-risk zones. Ensure that patrol staff promptly report and address potential risks such as unauthorized access or safety hazards.
* Inspection and Compliance. Conduct daily and weekly safety inspections of the property, ensuring compliance with fire safety standards, life safety protocols, and equipment readiness. Check firefighting systems, alarms, exit routes, and emergency signage for operational readiness.
* Incident Management. Ensure prompt response to any security or safety incidents, such as fire alarms, medical emergencies, or unauthorized access. Conduct post\-incident investigations, ensuring all relevant documentation is completed and corrective actions are taken.

3\. Access Control \& Surveillance Management.  

* Access Point Management. Oversee all access control points, ensuring the team diligently monitors and restricts unauthorized access to sensitive areas such as server rooms, storage, and restricted guest zones. Implement and enforce security protocols for visitors, contractors, and vendors.
* Surveillance Systems Oversight. Manage the surveillance systems, including CCTV, ensuring all cameras are operational and positioned strategically to cover key areas. Supervise the live monitoring process, ensuring that operators proactively report suspicious activity or security breaches in real\-time.
* Card Access Systems. Supervise the proper management of electronic access systems, ensuring accurate logging and review of access logs for sensitive or restricted areas.

4\. Fire \& Life Safety Management.  

* Fire Safety Protocols. Oversee the maintenance and readiness of fire detection systems, firefighting equipment, and evacuation routes. Ensure all fire drills are conducted in compliance with regulatory standards and property guidelines. Review fire safety protocols regularly to ensure optimal preparedness.
* Life Safety Preparedness. Manage life safety programs, including first aid, medical response, and emergency evacuation plans. Ensure all staff and relevant stakeholders are trained in emergency evacuation procedures and are aware of safety assembly points.
* Fire Drills and Emergency Simulations. Conduct regular fire drills, medical emergency simulations, and crisis scenario rehearsals with property staff to ensure preparedness for various emergencies.

5\. Risk Assessments, Audits, and Compliance.  

* Comprehensive Risk Management. Conduct comprehensive security and safety risk assessments on the property, identifying vulnerabilities in physical security, access control, and fire/life safety systems. Ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are put in place to address identified risks.

An ideal candidate should be well\-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.

* A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
* A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning

description:
**Workforce Compliance (Senior Manager)**

***The Team***

**Human Capital**


The Human Capital Offering Portfolio focuses on helping organizations manage and sustain their performance through their most important asset: their people. Centered on five core issues, this Portfolio signifies to the market that we see Human Capital as a topic critical to the C\-Suite. As we go\-to\-market we will show our clients that we serve more than HR organizations – from the CEO to CFO, Risk Manager to Business Unit leader—and that we deliver on our issues and help create value for our clients.

**Insights, Innovation and Operate**


As a Senior Manager in Workforce Compliance, you will serve as a senior leader within Deloitte’s Workforce Compliance practice, responsible for driving complex, multi\-workstream engagements, leading and growing high\-performing teams, and shaping the evolution of Deloitte’s Workforce Compliance solutions for both internal stakeholders and external clients.


You will combine deep workforce and HR regulatory expertise with strong program leadership, client advisory capabilities, and practice\-building mindset to help organizations proactively manage risk, remain compliant amid regulatory change, and optimize workforce operations at scale.

* Strong capability in regulatory research, interpretation, and analysis, with the ability to translate requirements into practical, business\-aligned guidance
* Expertise in performing compliance gap analyses, identifying regulatory and operational risks, and developing actionable remediation strategies
* Advanced program and project management skills, including managing large, complex, multi\-workstream engagements
* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management capabilities, including executive\-level communication and presentation skills
* Demonstrated people leadership skills, including mentoring, coaching, performance management, and team development
* Ability to build, scale, and evolve service offerings, methodologies, tools, and delivery models
* Experience supporting business development, including proposal development, capability presentations, and opportunity identification
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, subject matter experts, and global stakeholders

* Manage end\-to\-end project execution, including scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and financials
* Develop and manage resource and staffing plans, ensuring effective utilization throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Track project progress and deliverables; review and approve outputs to ensure alignment with Deloitte and client quality standards

* Drive the development and evolution of Workforce Compliance offerings, methodologies, tools, and frameworks

* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance culture

description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

title: HR Generalist
description:
As our HR Generalist, you will be the backbone of our HR \& Talent Acquisition operations and the support to the Head of HR. In this role, you will take ownership of our operational framework, ensuring that every process, from drafting contracts to managing precise monthly payroll, is executed timely and accurately. By managing BambooHR and taking ownership of our recruitment workflows, you ensure that our administrative processes are consistently accurate and our data remains reliable for all daily operations.

  

This role is primarily office\-based to support collaboration, teamwork, and visibility across the organisation. The HR Generalist is expected to work from the office 4 days per week, with 1 day per week working from home.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Talent Acquisition Execution**


* Manage the full\-cycle recruitment process for all open roles, from initial sourcing on job boards, to conducting screenings and coordinating hiring manager interviews.
* Draft and maintain accurate job descriptions and ensure all vacancies are posted on relevant industry boards and the JOI Careers page.
* Manage the candidate pipeline within BambooHR, ensuring timely feedback and a professional candidate experience.
* Conduct pre\-employment due diligence, including reference checks and right\-to\-work verifications.

  


**HR Operations \& Compliance**


* Serve as the administrator for BambooHR, ensuring all employee data, digital files, and lifecycle changes (promotions, salary adjustments) are 100% accurate.
* Manage all local statutory requirements, including the timely filing of engagement and termination forms.
* Draft employment contracts, addenda, and termination letters in strict accordance with local legislation and GDPR.
* Oversee the offboarding process, ensuring the recovery of company assets and completion of statutory documentation.

  


**Payroll Preparation \& Benefits Administration**


* Prepare the monthly pay\-run by collecting data on leave, bonuses, salary changes, etc., liaising directly with the external payroll providers and Finance team.
* Administer all employee benefits, including, but not limited to, monetary allowances and occupational pension scheme.
* Act as the first point of contact for employees regarding payroll queries, policy clarifications, and leave entitlements.

  


**Benefits**


* €1,000 Annual Wellness Allowance.
* Relocation package available for those joining us from abroad.
* Wellness \& Work\-Life Balance
* Employee Assistance Program \- €250 per annum
* Birthday Leave – enjoy an extra day off to celebrate your special day
* Anniversary Leave – enjoy an extra day for every year at Joi Gaming.
* Friday Drinks \& Lunch – a weekly get\-together to connect with your team
* Hybrid work – 1 day from home per week after your 6\-month probation
* Remote work abroad – work from anywhere for up to 1 month per year
* Free parking for cars and motorbikes

title: Sr. Specialist, Product Analysis – Core HR/P&C Products-1
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Sr. Specialist, Product Analysis – Core HR/P\&C Products\-1
Overview
  

  

The Sr. Specialist, Product Analysis converts defined product direction and business needs into detailed requirements, workflows, and system configurations across P\&C (HR) product domains.
  

  

Working closely with Product Managers, Experience Owners, HR stakeholders, Engineering, and enterprise systems teams, this role ensures product initiatives are clearly defined, validated, and successfully executed across a multi\-system HR environment, including Workday and other integrated platforms.
  

  

This role is responsible for end\-to\-end execution across the product delivery lifecycle, supporting requirements, configuration, testing, demos, UAT, and release activities to deliver high\-quality, scalable HR product capabilities.  

  

  

  

Opportunity \& Role Mission
  

  

This role offers the opportunity to support a modern HR Products organization delivering integrated HR experiences across Workday and a broader ecosystem of HR systems and platforms.
  

  

You will transform established product direction into build\-ready requirements and scalable system configurations, ensuring consistency and quality across systems and teams.
  

  

Your work will enable efficient delivery by ensuring requirements are complete, systems are properly configured, integrations are supported in partnership with engineering, dependencies are aligned, and releases are thoroughly validated.
  

  

What You’ll Do
  

  

Document business requirements, user stories, workflows, and system/configuration needs in partnership with Product Managers and stakeholders based on prioritized requests
  

  

Support system configuration and low\-/no\-code changes (including Workday and other HR platforms) within established product standards and governance
  

  

Partner with Engineering to support integration\-related requirements, validation, and issue resolution across interconnected HR systems
  

  

Execute test scripts, validate system changes, and support QA, demo readiness, and release deployment activities
  

  

Lead and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test planning, execution support, defect tracking, and stakeholder sign\-off
  

  

Provide day\-to\-day product and system support, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate resolution with Product, Engineering, and system owners
  

  

Maintain process documentation, configuration details, release notes, and testing records
  

  

Prepare and support product demos and stakeholder walkthroughs to validate functionality and readiness
  

  

Identify opportunities for incremental product, process, system, and user experience improvements
  

  

Partner across HR, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Engineering, and technology teams to support effective delivery, integration alignment, and adoption  

  

  

  

What You Bring
  

  

Experience in product analysis, business analysis, or HR technology roles with a strong focus on execution and delivery
  

  

Hands\-on experience with Workday\- including configuration (e.g., business processes, reporting, security, calculated fields), plus familiarity with other HR systems and platforms
  

  

Experience working in multi\-system environments, including supporting or coordinating with Engineering on integrations
  

  

Proven experience supporting QA, demos, UAT, and release processes
  

  

Strong analytical, documentation, and requirements management skills
  

  

Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements and system configurations
  

  

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy
  

  

Ability to operate independently and manage work across multiple priorities
  

  

Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross\-functional stakeholders
  

  

Experience with Agile tools and methodologies (e.g., Jira, Confluence, AHA)
  

  

Experience with HR domains such as
  

  

Core HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Absence, \& Time Tracking, Reporting (strongly preferred)
  

  

Experience with end\-user training or enablement (preferred)  

  

  

  

What Success Looks Like
  

  

Requirements are clear, complete, and ready for build without ambiguity or rework
  

  

Systems (including Workday and integrated platforms) are configured accurately and consistently
  

  

QA, demos, and UAT cycles are well\-executed and lead to high\-quality releases
  

  

Integrations and cross\-system workflows function reliably and as expected
  

  

Releases are stable, validated, and adopted with minimal defects
  

  

Issues are resolved efficiently through strong analysis, coordination, and execution
  

  

Documentation and supporting materials are complete, current, and enable adoption at scale
  

  

Continuous improvement is embedded across delivery processes, system configuration, and user experience**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior HR Generalist
description:
**Experience**
 10–12 years of experience in HR Operations, with at least 5–7 years in a managerial role.
   

  

**About Stellium**
 At Stellium (now Körber Stellium), we specialize in delivering SAP\-driven supply chain and digital transformation solutions. Our culture is built on innovation, ownership, and collaboration, creating an environment where people and ideas scale together to deliver meaningful enterprise impact.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Senior HR Generalist
   

  

 Location
   

  

 Mangalore (Onsite)
   

  

**Job Description**
 Stellium is seeking an experienced Senior Manager – HR Operations to lead and strengthen our HR operational framework as the organization continues to expand globally. This role is critical in ensuring seamless execution of people processes, maintaining compliance, enhancing employee experience, and supporting HR digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Operations \& Service Delivery: Lead and oversee end\-to\-end HR operations for India while supporting global requirements, ensuring seamless execution of all employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, and offboarding, maintaining data accuracy in HR systems, and driving standardization of HR processes across locations.
* HRIS \& Digital Enablement (SuccessFactors): Own governance of SuccessFactors by ensuring data accuracy and process compliance, coordinating system enhancements and integrations with the technology team, driving automation of manual HR workflows, and developing dashboards and analytics to support leadership decision\-making.
* Compliance \& Policy Governance: Ensure adherence to statutory and labour law requirements, including PF, ESI, gratuity, and regulatory filings. Liaise with statutory consultants to ensure timely compliance and audit readiness. Continuously review and refine HR policies to align with organizational growth and culture.
* Employee Experience \& HR Support: Oversee HR helpdesk operations to ensure timely resolution of employee queries, partner with business leaders to address workplace concerns and escalations, and drive consistent HR communication, announcements, and policy awareness across offices.
* Payroll Coordination: Support payroll processing by managing inputs such as new hires, exits, compensation changes, attendance data, allowances, and deductions, while collaborating closely with Finance and external payroll partners to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* HR Projects \& Transformation Initiatives: Lead HR transformation initiatives aligned with organizational priorities, including digitization journeys, experience center operations, and campus integration programs, while implementing best practices from consulting and technology industries to enhance HR operational effectiveness.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or related field.
* Strong expertise in HR operations, statutory compliance, and HRIS systems (preferably SuccessFactors).
* Proven ability to manage complex HR workflows and multi\-location operations.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience in HR metrics and reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in technology, consulting, or supply chain domains.
* Prior experience in scaling HR operations in a fast\-growing organization.
* Exposure to global HR operations and multi\-region workforce management.

***Stellium is an equal opportunity employer.***
 It is our policy at Stellium Inc. that all applicants for employment are recruited, hired, and assigned based on merit without discrimination because of race, religion, color, gender, age, national origin, disability, or veteran status. The employment policies and practices of Stellium Inc have been and will continue to be such as ensuring that all employees are treated equally and that no distinctions are made in compensation or opportunities for advancement, including upgrading, promotion, and transfer based on personal characteristics unrelated to job performance.

**Location: Rajkot, Gujarat (Onsite)** 




**Experience: 8\-15 years in the HR Field** 




**What you will be doing:** 




 We are seeking a mature, dependable, and business\-focused HR Manager who will be responsible for driving operational excellence across HR functions while effectively managing employee relations, supporting organizational decision\-making, and contributing to long\-term people strategies.
 



 This role demands an HR professional who combines strong execution capabilities with analytical thinking and strategic judgment. The ideal candidate will be capable of handling complex employee situations, improving organizational effectiveness, interpreting policies fairly, and partnering with leadership to align people practices with business objectives.
 



 The role requires a balanced approach towards employee experience, operational discipline, workforce insights, and business growth in a dynamic and evolving organization.
 



 Summary:
 



 We are looking for an HR manager who is people\-centric, approachable, and committed to long\-term growth. The ideal candidate will have a soft\-spoken and empathetic approach while balancing operational execution needs with employee well\-being.
 



**Job Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Employee Relations \& Grievance Management** 




 ● Act as the primary HR contact for employee concerns, workplace confl icts, and sensitive people matters.
 



 ● Handle grievance cases with fairness, confi dentiality, and professionalism.
 



 ● Interpret and implement HR policies consistently while balancing employee and business needs.
 



 ● Support managers in resolving employee issues and making effective people decisions.
 



**2\. HR Operations \& Organizational Effectiveness** 




 ● Ensure smooth execution of key HR processes across the employee lifecycle.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence through process improvements and standardization.
 



 ● Collaborate with stakeholders to enhance employee experience and organizational effectiveness.
 



 ● Maintain operational discipline while adapting to evolving business needs.
 



**3\. Decision Support \& HR Analytics** 




 ● Analyze workforce data, employee trends, and HR metrics to support decision\-making.
 



 ● Prepare HR reports, dashboards, and actionable insights for management.
 



 ● Recommend improvements based on data, observations, and business requirements.
 



 ● Support implementation of HR initiatives, policies, and organizational programs.
 



**4\. Leadership \& Strategic HR Partnership** 




 ● Partner with leadership on employee\-related decisions and organizational priorities.
 



 ● Guide HR team members in execution quality and issue resolution.
 



 ● Demonstrate ownership and sound judgment in managing day\-to\-day HR responsibilities.
 



 ● Support organizational stability during change, escalations, and business challenges.
 



**5\. Collaboration with Administration Department** 




 ● Work closely with Administration to ensure seamless employee\-related operations.
 



 ● Coordinate HR initiatives, employee engagement activities, and training programs.
 



 ● Promote alignment between HR and Administration functions.
 



**6\. Special Projects \& Initiatives** 




 ● Lead assigned HR initiatives and cross\-functional projects.
 



 ● Contribute to programs that strengthen culture, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.
 



**Required Skills:** 




 ● Strong experience in HR Operations and Employee Relations management.
 



 ● Excellent grievance handling, confl ict resolution, and policy interpretation capabilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical thinking with the ability to derive meaningful insights from workforce data.
 



 ● Ability to make practical, balanced, and business\-oriented people decisions.
 



 ● Strong stakeholder management, interpersonal infl uence, and communication skills.
 



 ● Proven capability to manage ambiguity and complex employee situations effectively.
 



 ● High ownership, accountability, emotional maturity, and professional judgment.
 



 ● Strong process orientation with a focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
 



 ● Understanding of HRMS platforms, HR analytics, and modern HR practices.
 



 ● Ability to think strategically while remaining execution\-focused.
 



**Must\-Haves:** 




**● 8\-15 years of experience in HR, preferably in a mid\-sized IT or ERP company** 




**● Proven ability to execute HR operations and ensure timely process delivery** 




**● Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms and HR documentation** 




**● Passionate about building a positive, people\-centric workplace** 




**● Hands\-on experience in statutory compliance, preferably in a regional scope**

title: UX/UI Design Intern
description:
UI/UX Design Intern

**Location:** Jaipur

**Company:** Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd

About Us

Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd is a dynamic and innovative tech firm dedicated to delivering high\-quality digital products. We pride ourselves on our architectural approach to software and our commitment to excellence. We are currently seeking a meticulous and forward\-thinking **UI/UX Design Intern** to join our product team and help build the visual foundation of our applications.

Job Description

We are looking for a UI/UX Intern who doesn't just "make things look pretty" but understands the mechanics of a scalable design system. You will be deeply involved in crafting high\-fidelity interfaces, building reusable components, and mapping out complex user flows. This is an ideal role for someone who is obsessed with **Figma**, loves organized layers, and wants to see their prototypes turn into real\-world products.

Responsibilities

* **Scalable UI Design:** Design modern, clean, and responsive interfaces for web and mobile applications using Figma.
* **Design Systems:** Assist in building and maintaining a robust design library, including the use of **Figma Variables** (colors, spacing, modes) and **Auto Layout** for scalable growth.
* **Prototyping:** Create interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and micro\-interactions.
* **Wireframing:** Translate complex project requirements into functional wireframes and low\-fidelity blueprints.
* **User Research:** Collaborate with our Business Analysts to understand user personas and iterate designs based on feedback and data.
* **Handoff:** Prepare design files for the development team, ensuring all assets and specifications are clear and implementable.
* **Consistency:** Ensure all screens align with brand guidelines and maintain a high level of visual and functional polish.

Requirements

* Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Interaction Design, HCI, Graphic Design, or a related field.
* **Figma Power User:** Advanced knowledge of Figma is a must (Components, Variants, Auto Layout, and Prototyping).
* Strong understanding of **UX principles**, typography, color theory, and grid systems.
* A portfolio that showcases your process—from initial wireframes to polished, scalable UI screens.
* Excellent attention to detail (you're the type who notices a 1px misalignment).
* Ability to take constructive feedback and iterate quickly in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with **Figma Variables** and advanced prototyping features.
* Basic understanding of how designs translate to code (HTML/CSS/React logic).
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop/Illustrator) for asset creation.
* Interest in specialized industries like e\-commerce or inventory management systems.

What We Offer

* **Technical Growth:** Deep dive into advanced UI/UX workflows and design system architecture.
* **Mentorship:** Work directly with our product team to learn how design impacts business logic.
* **Real Impact:** Your designs won't just sit in a folder; they will be the blueprint for our live applications.
* **Culture:** A supportive, tech\-driven environment in Jaipur where innovation is encouraged.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Design: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description:
**About Us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organisations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you will be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As a UI/UX Design Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with designers, product managers, business analysts, and developers to create intuitive, user\-centric digital experiences for web and mobile applications.

You will contribute to real\-world projects — designing wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and interaction flows — while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into thoughtful design solutions.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end product design, design systems, UX research, and AI\-assisted design workflows. You will contribute to real design cycles while learning how fast\-growing product teams build scalable, structured design processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong visual thinking, attention to detail, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles, design thinking, and user\-centred design.
* Familiarity with Figma — components, auto layout, variants, and prototyping.
* Knowledge of user flows, wireframing, information architecture, and responsive design.
* Basic familiarity with FigJam, AI\-powered design tools, and accessibility best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Freshers and students are welcome. Academic projects, personal UI/UX work, or a portfolio are a strong plus.
* Interest in SaaS, AI, Healthcare, or startup products is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

UX Design \& Wireframing

* Assist in creating wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and document user flows, web flows, and interaction flows.
* Create user\-centric designs that focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive experiences.
* Contribute to solving user and business problems through thoughtful design solutions.

UI Design \& Design Systems

* Support UI design activities across web and mobile platforms.
* Assist in developing and maintaining design systems and reusable components.
* Create and maintain design documentation using Figma and FigJam.

Research \& Collaboration

* Participate in user research, competitor analysis, and design discussions.
* Work with product and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into design solutions.
* Participate in design reviews and improve designs based on structured feedback.

AI\-Assisted Design

* Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, and wireframing.
* Explore opportunities to integrate AI\-powered design tools into existing workflows.

**Work Style Expectations**

* Takes ownership from wireframe to final handoff — no step\-by\-step hand\-holding needed.
* Thinks in systems, not just screens; cares about design rationale, not just aesthetics.
* Communicates design decisions clearly with developers, product managers, and founders.
* Proactively identifies gaps, asks clarifying questions, and improves workflows without waiting for instructions.
* Handles multiple tasks in parallel with consistent attention to detail and visual quality.
* Disciplined with documentation, component libraries, and version control.
* Comfortable with fast feedback cycles, tight timelines, and shifting priorities.
* Curious about AI tools, automation, and making design workflows more efficient.
* We value design quality, ownership, and structured thinking — more than credentials alone.
* Candidates who copy templates without understanding context may struggle in this role.

**This Role May Not Be a Good Fit If**

* You prefer repetitive production work with fixed instructions for every design task.
* You struggle with iteration, design feedback, or maintaining visual and interaction consistency.
* You are uncomfortable with fast\-paced startup environments where product requirements can evolve quickly.
* You dislike structured design documentation, component systems, or process\-oriented design work.
* You prefer low\-ownership environments with limited accountability over design outcomes.

**Internship Structure**

* **The duration of the internship is 3 months.**
* Interns who demonstrate strong performance, design ownership, learning ability, and meaningful contribution may be considered for internship extension

**Who You Will Work With**

You will work closely with the Design, Product, and Engineering teams at V7 AI Solutions. You will gain hands\-on exposure to cross\-functional collaboration, real product cycles, and the end\-to\-end workflow of building digital products in a fast\-moving startup environment.

**What You Will Learn**

During this internship, you will gain practical exposure to:

* End\-to\-end product design workflow
* UX research and requirement analysis
* User flow and web flow creation
* Design systems and component\-based design
* Real\-world collaboration with product and engineering teams
* AI\-assisted design processes
* Product thinking and problem\-solving approaches

**What Success Looks Like**

* Design deliverables are completed on time, with high quality and clear rationale.
* Product and engineering teams receive reliable, well\-documented design assets.
* User flows, prototypes, and design systems are accurate, organised, and reusable.
* Designs consistently reflect user needs, business goals, and usability principles.
* Design workflows become more structured, scalable, and efficient over time.

**Why Join Us**

At V7 AI Solutions, you will work in a fast\-moving environment where your design contribution directly impacts product quality and user experience.

This internship is ideal for individuals who enjoy solving design problems, thinking about users, building scalable systems, and contributing meaningfully in a high\-ownership startup environment.

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
**Pavan Enterprise**, an authorized channel partner of Karcher Professional Cleaning Equipment, is looking for a dedicated and technically skilled **Field Service Engineer** to join our growing team. We specialize in the sales, installation, maintenance, and repair of professional cleaning machines, including vacuum cleaners, high\-pressure washers, scrubber driers, sweepers, carpet cleaners, and other industrial cleaning equipment.

The selected candidate will be responsible for installing and commissioning machines at customer sites, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, carrying out preventive maintenance, and providing prompt after\-sales service. The role also involves training customers on the proper operation and maintenance of equipment, preparing service reports, and coordinating with the internal team to ensure high customer satisfaction.

Candidates should have an ITI, Diploma, or Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics, or a related technical field. Prior experience in servicing industrial machinery or cleaning equipment will be an advantage, although motivated freshers with strong technical aptitude may also apply. The ideal candidate should possess good troubleshooting skills, a customer\-focused attitude, and a willingness to travel for field visits.

At Pavan Enterprise, we value professionalism, reliability, and continuous learning. We offer competitive compensation, technical training on Karcher products, opportunities for career growth, and a supportive work environment.

If you are passionate about technical service and enjoy working directly with customers to solve problems, we would be pleased to hear from you. Join Pavan Enterprise and become part of a team committed to delivering quality solutions and exceptional service in the professional cleaning equipment industry.

title: Qentelli - Performance Test Engineer - LoadRunner/JMeter
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Performance Test Engineer with 3\-10 years of experience in performance engineering, load testing, and application performance monitoring.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in LoadRunner, JMeter, Postman, and New Relic to design, execute, and analyze performance tests for web, mobile, API, and enterprise applications.
   

  

 The role involves identifying performance bottlenecks, collaborating with development and infrastructure teams, and ensuring applications meet scalability, reliability, and performance requirements.
   

  

**Required Skills (Mandatory)**
* Strong hands\-on experience with LoadRunner for performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing.
* Expertise in Apache JMeter for web and API performance testing.
* Proficiency in Postman for API validation, testing, and automation.
* Experience with New Relic for application performance monitoring, diagnostics, and root cause analysis.
* Strong understanding of performance testing methodologies and best practices.
* Experience in workload modeling, test scenario design, and test data management.
* Knowledge of performance metrics such as response time, throughput, latency, resource utilization, and error rates.
* Experience in analyzing server\-side and application\-level performance bottlenecks.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and execute performance test scripts using LoadRunner and JMeter.
* Create realistic workload models and test scenarios based on business requirements.
* Perform load, stress, spike, endurance, volume, and scalability testing.
* Develop and execute API performance tests using Postman and other testing tools.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using New Relic and other monitoring solutions.
* Analyze test results and identify application, database, network, and infrastructure bottlenecks.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to resolve performance issues.
* Prepare detailed performance test reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Establish performance benchmarks, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.
* Support performance testing activities across multiple environments, including QA, staging, and production.
* Participate in performance tuning initiatives and capacity planning exercises.
* Automate performance testing processes and integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure adherence to performance engineering standards, processes, and best practices.
* Conduct root cause analysis for production performance issues and provide remediation recommendations.


**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
* Programming knowledge in Python, Java, C, VB Script, Shell Scripting, and Node.js.
* Experience in test automation and framework development.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
* Experience with log monitoring and observability tools.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
* Knowledge of API testing tools and service virtualization.
* Experience working in enterprise\-scale distributed environments.

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation

* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team

-----

Deliver

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Financials

Capability Building

Team Management
  

  

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score
